notes: The two branches meet at سفيان (the first branch «أنبأنا سفيان», the second «عن سفيان»); what follows, «علقمة بن مرثد، ... سليمان بن بريدة، ... عن أبيه», is written once after the meeting and is the shared tail
«أبيه» is named only by relation; the Companion is not named in the text, so he stays a relation link
The dashed-gloss-free text; the question and answer of the story are the saying, not routes
